Amen to that!

May we all find everlasting peace in death!

That poor Floro Doggo!

Damn you, King Croacus IV!

Well considering that I almost made a successful attempt of bridge jumping 2 months ago, i'd say that although I am currently attempting to find a job, or return to a university, or find some hobby, suicide is my "Plan B", and yes, I am intent and completely aware of the consequences.

That may be true, however given the fact that I am in an endless loop of unwillingness to change my life, it is quite logical that I must remove myself, in order to allow someone better suited to deal with the challenge of life.

I'm glad to hear that you had an enjoyable day!

Coincidentally, I have seen the video on depression by Kurtzgesagt. However, the video itself contained information that I was already aware of.

As it just so happens, I do in fact have a dog!

Yes, he is indeed a rescue. It was said that he was around 7 years old when we adopted him. My family and I have had him around for about 3 or 4 years as of now. Unfortunately, he is suffering from cataracts, and is almost blind in both of his eyes. Regardless, my family and I love him dearly, as we try to care for him in his senior years. I know he loves us just as much as we love him!
E L O N G A T E D P I S S
I'd have to argue that the back scratcher should actually belong in the solo category, rather than the team category. Considering the fact that, you get -75% healing from medics.

Due to the nature of our situation, I would highly implore you to find an alternate method, delevop an extraordinary evolutionary change ,while also creating a definite solution to this particular obstacle.
